literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 通过观察细胞病变效应证实了适应过程,Vero E6细胞中的病毒滴度增加至1.72×107 FFU/mL。 [10.1007/s00705-026-06717-y]
总共发现了 14,343 起通知,其中狗的暴露量最多,而与猫相关的事件随着时间的推移而增加;15 岁以下儿童在通知中占很大比例。 [10.1177/10806032261472436]
mRNA-LNP制剂诱导可检测的体液和细胞免疫应答,包括狂犬病病毒特异性IgG产生和抗原特异性T细胞激活,并且与mRNA和亚基疫苗的联合免疫进一步增强了免疫应答,实现了694.5 IU/mL的峰值狂犬病病毒特异性IgG滴度。 [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199785]
提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.26180/33250149.v1]
在糖尿病中风小鼠模型中,与游离 FGF1 相比,FGF1-RVG Exo 表现出更优异的药理功效,只需每周一次给药即可实现稳健的治疗效果。急性期单剂量可引起持续长达两周的持续降血糖作用,并有效改善全身胰岛素抵抗。 [10.1002/advs.77064]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The adaptation process was confirmed by observing cytopathic effects, and the viral titer increased to 1.72 × 107 FFU/mL in Vero E6 cells. [10.1007/s00705-026-06717-y]

A total of 14,343 notifications were identified, with dogs accounting for most exposures and cat-related incidents increasing over time; children under 15 years represented a substantial proportion of notifications. [10.1177/10806032261472436]

The mRNA-LNP formulation induced detectable humoral and cellular immune responses, including rabies virus-specific IgG production and antigen-specific T-cell activation, and co-immunization with mRNA and subunit vaccines further enhanced immune responses, achieving peak rabies virus-specific IgG titers of 694.5 IU/mL. [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199785]
The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.26180/33250149.v1]

In the diabetic stroke mouse model, FGF1-RVG Exo demonstrated superior pharmacological efficacy compared to free FGF1, achieving robust therapeutic outcomes with only once-weekly administration. [10.1002/advs.77064]

news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 农业部动植物卫生检验局 (APHIS) 宣布计划通过飞机、直升机、车辆和诱饵站分发数百万个口服 狂犬病 疫苗,以防止浣熊 狂犬病 的传播。据报道,该计划是政府的正式行动。 [news-e1a4c22ae366380d]
本文提供了关于 狂犬病 和反 狂犬病 狂犬病 的历史和当代视角,详细介绍了 Louis Pasteur 于 1885 年开发的第一个 狂犬病 疫苗 及其对 狂犬病 预防的影响。它还讨论了现代 疫苗 类型及其相对于旧式基于神经组织的 疫苗 的优势。该事件不是暴发,而是对狂犬病及其预防的回顾。 [news-fb0513d48617ce09]
狂犬病:仔细观察“最致命的疾病”。 [news-07538423c278c6d7]
一名来自加拿大的 11 岁男孩在直接接触蝙蝠后患上了 狂犬病,最初被误诊为疱疹感染和贝尔麻痹。诊断 通过唾液样本的聚合酶链反应测试得到证实。 [news-d562b04435cc0a84]
据 CVO 报道,2021 年至 2026 年,达沃市记录了 34 例确诊的人类 狂犬病 死亡事件。死亡原因包括宠物主人不负责任、疫苗接种 延迟以及动物咬伤后未能立即就医。 [news-fbf8bb1b1e5ba0ba]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Department of Agriculture's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) announced a plan to distribute millions of oral rabies vaccines via airplane, helicopter, vehicle, and bait stations to prevent the spread of raccoon rabies. The program is reported as an official government action. [news-e1a4c22ae366380d]

The article provides a historical and contemporary perspective on rabies and anti-rabies vaccinations, detailing the development of the first rabies vaccine by Louis Pasteur in 1885 and its impact on rabies prevention. It also discusses modern vaccine types and their advantages over older nerve tissue-based vaccines. [news-fb0513d48617ce09]
Rabies: A closer look at the 'deadliest disease'. [news-07538423c278c6d7]

An 11-year-old boy from Canada developed rabies after a direct contact with a bat, which was initially misdiagnosed as a herpes infection and Bell palsy. The diagnosis was confirmed through polymerase chain reaction testing of saliva samples. [news-d562b04435cc0a84]

Davao City recorded 34 confirmed human rabies deaths from 2021 to 2026, as reported by the CVO. The deaths were attributed to gaps in responsible pet ownership, delayed vaccination, and failure to seek immediate medical attention after animal bites. [news-fbf8bb1b1e5ba0ba]

papers.title: Adaptation of wild-type rabies virus on vaccine producing cell line and its quantification by peroxidase-based immunostaining
papers.abstract: Rabies lyssavirus, the causative agent of rabies (acute progressive encephalomyelitis) requires specific receptors on host cell to mediate neurotropism. Typically, cell lines used for rabies vaccine production are devoid of these receptors. In this study, we developed and optimized a protocol for adapting a locally isolated wild type rabies virus belonging to the Arctic-like lineage A1a, to a vaccine producing cell line, quantified its infectious titer using peroxidase-based immunostaining and virus neutralization was assessed using sera obtained from Abhayrab®-vaccinated individuals. The virus was initially propagated in mouse neuroblastoma cell line and gradually adapted to replicate in Vero E6 by serial passages. The adaptation was confirmed by cytopathic effect and the viral titer rose to as high as 1.72 × 107 FFU/mL. This is the first study to provide a detailed documentation of significant and typical cytopathic effect induced by an Arctic-like A1a lineage RABV in Vero E6 cells.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 狂犬病毒是 狂犬病(急性进行性脑脊髓炎)的病原体,需要 宿主 细胞上的特定受体来介导向神经性。本研究旨在解决将野生型 疫苗 适应产生 疫苗 的细胞系的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及通过连续传代将本地分离的野生型 狂犬病病毒 适应产生 疫苗 的细胞系。该病毒最初在小鼠神经母细胞瘤细胞中繁殖,后来适应在 Vero E6 细胞中复制。
elements_zh.methods: 开发并优化了一种协议,用于使野生型 狂犬病病毒 适应产生 疫苗 的细胞系。使用基于过氧化物酶的免疫染色对病毒感染滴度进行定量,并使用来自 Abhayrab® 疫苗接种者的血清评估病毒中和作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 通过观察细胞病变效应证实了适应过程,Vero E6细胞中的病毒滴度增加至1.72×107 FFU/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究首次详细记录了类似 Arctic A1a 谱系 狂犬病病毒 在 Vero E6 细胞中诱导的显着且典型的细胞病变效应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解 疫苗 生产的 疫苗 适应,这可能为 疫苗 开发和质量控制的改进方法提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外适应,不包括体内验证,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。由于缺乏更广泛的生物学或临床背景,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Expression and Immunogenicity of a Rabies Virus Glycoprotein-HSV-2 ICP35 Fusion Antigen Delivered by an mRNA-LNP Formulation.
papers.abstract: Rabies virus (RABV) is a zoonotic pathogen with an almost 100% case-fatality rate and limited post-exposure prophylaxis options. mRNA-based antigen delivery represents a promising approach but requires further optimization. We prepared a cationic lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery system using the thin-film hydration method and characterized its physicochemical properties and delivery efficiency. An mRNA encoding a fusion antigen comprising rabies virus glycoprotein (G) and herpes simplex virus type 2 infected cell polypeptide 35 (ICP35), lacking canonical 5' and 3' untranslated region sequences, was constructed. In vitro protein expression of the G-ICP35 mRNA was confirmed. Immunogenicity was evaluated in BALB/c mice following three intramuscular immunizations with G-ICP35 mRNA, RABV G/N proteins, or their combination. Tail vein blood samples were collected on days 7, 21, and 39 after the final immunization, and rabies virus-specific antibody titers and T-cell responses were assessed. The cationic LNP formulation efficiently mediated intracellular delivery and expression of the G-ICP35 mRNA. In vivo, the mRNA-LNP formulation induced detectable humoral and cellular immune responses, including rabies virus-specific IgG production and antigen-specific T-cell activation. Notably, co-immunization with mRNA and subunit vaccines further enhanced immune responses compared with either vaccine alone, achieving peak rabies virus-specific IgG titers of 694.5 IU/mL. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of a DC-Chol-based mRNA-LNP formulation for fusion antigen delivery and support further investigation of combined mRNA and subunit vaccine strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies virus causes a nearly uniformly fatal zoonotic infection with limited post-exposure prophylaxis options, and mRNA-based antigen delivery systems require further optimization to improve immunogenicity and practical deployment.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated an mRNA vaccine encoding a rabies virus glycoprotein–herpes simplex virus type 2 ICP35 fusion antigen delivered via a cationic lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation in BALB/c mice, using intramuscular immunization with three doses.
analysis.methods: A cationic LNP delivery system was prepared by thin-film hydration, characterized for physicochemical properties and delivery efficiency, and used to encapsulate an mRNA construct lacking canonical 5′ and 3′ untranslated regions; immunogenicity was assessed by rabies virus-specific antibody titers and T-cell responses after immunization.
analysis.main_results: The mRNA-LNP formulation induced detectable humoral and cellular immune responses, including rabies virus-specific IgG production and antigen-specific T-cell activation, and co-immunization with mRNA and subunit vaccines further enhanced immune responses, achieving peak rabies virus-specific IgG titers of 694.5 IU/mL.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating the feasibility of a DC-Chol-based mRNA-LNP formulation for fusion antigen delivery and support further investigation of combined mRNA and subunit vaccine strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest potential for improved rabies vaccine strategies by leveraging mRNA-LNP platforms and combination regimens to enhance immunogenicity, which may inform future vaccine design and optimization.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its exclusive use of a mouse model, absence of challenge data to assess protective efficacy, and reliance on short-term immunogenicity endpoints, warranting cautious interpretation and further validation in relevant animal models or humans.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed an mRNA vaccine encoding a rabies virus glycoprotein–HSV-2 ICP35 fusion antigen delivered via a cationic lipid nanoparticle (LNP) in BALB/c mice. The mRNA-LNP formulation induced detectable humoral and cellular immune responses, including rabies virus-specific IgG and antigen-specific T-cell activation. Co-immunization with mRNA and subunit vaccines further enhanced immune responses, achieving peak rabies virus-specific IgG titers of 694.5 IU/mL. The authors conclude that a DC-Chol-based mRNA-LNP platform is feasible for fusion antigen delivery and propose combined vaccine strategies for further investigation. However, the study is limited by its mouse model, lack of challenge data, and short-term endpoints, which constrain the strength of evidence and generalizability.

papers.title_zh: 由 mRNA-LNP 制剂递送的 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白-HSV-2 ICP35 融合抗原的表达和免疫原性。
papers.source_body_en: Rabies virus (RABV) is a zoonotic pathogen with an almost 100% case-fatality rate and limited post-exposure prophylaxis options. mRNA-based antigen delivery represents a promising approach but requires further optimization. We prepared a cationic lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery system using the thin-film hydration method and characterized its physicochemical properties and delivery efficiency. An mRNA encoding a fusion antigen comprising rabies virus glycoprotein (G) and herpes simplex virus type 2 infected cell polypeptide 35 (ICP35), lacking canonical 5' and 3' untranslated region sequences, was constructed. In vitro protein expression of the G-ICP35 mRNA was confirmed. Immunogenicity was evaluated in BALB/c mice following three intramuscular immunizations with G-ICP35 mRNA, RABV G/N proteins, or their combination. Tail vein blood samples were collected on days 7, 21, and 39 after the final immunization, and rabies virus-specific antibody titers and T-cell responses were assessed. The cationic LNP formulation efficiently mediated intracellular delivery and expression of the G-ICP35 mRNA. In vivo, the mRNA-LNP formulation induced detectable humoral and cellular immune responses, including rabies virus-specific IgG production and antigen-specific T-cell activation. Notably, co-immunization with mRNA and subunit vaccines further enhanced immune responses compared with either vaccine alone, achieving peak rabies virus-specific IgG titers of 694.5 IU/mL. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of a DC-Chol-based mRNA-LNP formulation for fusion antigen delivery and support further investigation of combined mRNA and subunit vaccine strategies.

papers.title: Territorial and Programmatic Determinants of Human Rabies Exposure and Postexposure Prophylaxis in Brazil: A Population-Based Municipal Study
papers.abstract: Introduction Human rabies exposure occurs at the interface between urban areas, peri-urban environments, and health surveillance systems. This study analyzed territorial and programmatic dimensions of human rabies exposure and postexposure management in a Brazilian municipality. Methods A population-based ecological study used secondary surveillance data from the Brazilian Notifiable Diseases Information System from 2007 to 2025. All notified human rabies exposure events were included. Variables included age, animal species involved, type of exposure, and postexposure prophylaxis management. Incidence rates per 100,000 inhabitants were calculated. Results A total of 14,343 notifications were identified. Dogs accounted for most of the exposures, although cat-related incidents increased over time. Children <15 y of age represented a substantial proportion of notifications. Incidence increased over time, particularly after 2010. Most exposures were classified as preventable events requiring postexposure prophylaxis. Conclusions Human rabies exposure in this setting reflects persistent vulnerabilities at the urban-wildlife interface and challenges in postexposure management. Strengthening surveillance, responsible animal ownership, and One Health strategies are essential to reduce preventable exposures.

papers.title_zh: 巴西人类 狂犬病 暴露和暴露后预防的地域和程序决定因素:基于人口的城市研究
papers.source_body_en: Introduction Human rabies exposure occurs at the interface between urban areas, peri-urban environments, and health surveillance systems. This study analyzed territorial and programmatic dimensions of human rabies exposure and postexposure management in a Brazilian municipality. Methods A population-based ecological study used secondary surveillance data from the Brazilian Notifiable Diseases Information System from 2007 to 2025. All notified human rabies exposure events were included. Variables included age, animal species involved, type of exposure, and postexposure prophylaxis management. Incidence rates per 100,000 inhabitants were calculated. Results A total of 14,343 notifications were identified. Dogs accounted for most of the exposures, although cat-related incidents increased over time. Children <15 y of age represented a substantial proportion of notifications. Incidence increased over time, particularly after 2010. Most exposures were classified as preventable events requiring postexposure prophylaxis. Conclusions Human rabies exposure in this setting reflects persistent vulnerabilities at the urban-wildlife interface and challenges in postexposure management. Strengthening surveillance, responsible animal ownership, and One Health strategies are essential to reduce preventable exposures.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 人类 狂犬病 暴露发生在城市地区、城郊环境和健康 监测 系统之间的交界处。本研究分析了巴西某市人类 狂犬病 暴露和暴露后管理的地域和规划维度。方法 基于人群的生态研究使用了 2007 年至 2025 年巴西法定疾病信息系统的二次 监测 数据。所有已通报的人类 狂犬病 暴露事件均包括在内。变量包括年龄、涉及的动物种类、暴露类型和暴露后预防管理。计算了每 100,000 名居民的 发病率 比率。结果 共识别出 14,343 份通知。尽管与猫相关的事件随着时间的推移而增加,但狗占了大部分暴露量。15 岁以下的儿童在通知中占很大比例。发病率 随着时间的推移而增加,特别是在 2010 年之后。大多数暴露被归类为需要暴露后预防的可预防事件。结论 在这种环境下人类 狂犬病 暴露反映了城市与野生动物界面的持续脆弱性以及暴露后管理的挑战。加强 监测、负责任的动物所有权和同一个健康战略对于减少可预防的接触至关重要。

papers.title: A new role for an old player: The rabies virus phosphoprotein as an RNA chaperone, helicase, and immune evasion hub
papers.abstract: Rabies virus (RABV) remains one of the most lethal pathogens known, with a case-fatality rate approaching 100% once clinical symptoms appear. Despite effective post-exposure prophylaxis, thousands of deaths occur annually, and breakthrough infections remain a concern.1 The viral phosphoprotein (P) is a multifunctional hub essential for transcription, replication, and immune evasion, yet its full repertoire of activities has remained incompletely understood. The study by Mu and colleagues, published in the March issue of Molecular Therapy Nucleic Acids, uncovers a remarkable new facet of this protein: RABV-P possesses both NTP-dependent helicase-like and NTP-independent RNA chaperone activities, representing the first demonstration of such functions in the Rhabdoviridae family.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 暴露后预防 (RABV) 导致几乎普遍致命的脑炎,尽管 暴露后预防 有效,但每年仍有数千人死亡,人们对突破性感染的持续担忧。该研究旨在阐明病毒磷蛋白(P)的未充分表征的功能,该蛋白对于转录、复制和免疫逃避至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是发表在《分子治疗核酸》上的一项机制研究,利用生化和分子测定来检查 狂犬病病毒 磷蛋白 (P) 的酶活性和伴侣活性。
analysis_zh.methods: 作者采用生化测定来表征磷蛋白的 NTP 依赖性解旋酶样和 NTP 独立性 RNA 伴侣活性,并将这些功能与已知的病毒和细胞对应物进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究表明,狂犬病病毒 磷蛋白 (P) 具有 NTP 依赖性解旋酶样和 NTP 独立 RNA 伴侣活性,代表弹状病毒科中首次发现此类功能。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了 RABV-P 以前未被认识的多功能作用,将其已知的功能扩展到转录和免疫逃避之外,包括解旋酶和伴侣活性,这可能有助于理解病毒复制和 发病机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对 RABV-P 酶功能的 抗病毒药物 策略的开发提供信息,从而可能导致针对 狂犬病 感染的新治疗方法。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于体外生化测定,缺乏体内验证或临床相关性,这限制了结论的强度及其对公共卫生或治疗开发的直接适用性。

papers.title: Genomic analysis of the modulation of immune signalling by rabies virus P protein
papers.abstract: The ability of viruses to evade immunity is critical to disease, presenting targets for vaccine and antivirals development. The principal antiviral response of cells is mediated by interferons, which activate STAT proteins to induce hundreds of genes including antiviral genes. Viruses counter this by expressing ‘interferon-antagonist’ proteins, many of which inhibit STATs. Interferon-antagonists are typically considered to shut down interferon responses, but many interferon-regulated genes have ‘pro-viral’ functions. How viruses coordinate the need to suppress some genes but not others are poorly understood. Using a well-characterised interferon-antagonist, our data indicate that by selectively targeting certain cytokine-activated pathways, interferon-antagonists can inhibit the effects of interferon on specific subsets of IRGs (including antiviral genes) while permitting effects on others (including proviral genes); thus, interferon-antagonists may be defined as selective ‘interferon-modulators.

papers.title: Engineered Brain-Targeted Exosomes Delivering FGF1 for Sustained Glycemic Regulation and Multitarget Neurovascular Protection in Diabetic Stroke.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Diabetic stroke is characterized by a hyperglycemic and pro‐inflammatory microenvironment that exacerbates neurovascular dysfunction. However, the blood–brain barrier (BBB) remains a formidable obstacle, restricting the delivery of most therapeutic molecules. To address this, we developed a non‐invasive treatment strategy using engineered exosomes. Specifically, we fabricated FGF1‐loaded exosomes functionalized with the rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG) peptide (FGF1‐RVG Exo). This platform facilitates selective, neuron‐targeted delivery of FGF1 to the ischemic penumbra via RVG‐mediated transcytosis. In a diabetic stroke mouse model, FGF1‐RVG Exo exhibited superior pharmacological efficacy compared to free FGF1, achieving robust therapeutic outcomes with only once‐weekly administration. Notably, a single dose during the acute phase elicited a sustained hypoglycemic effect lasting up to two weeks and effectively ameliorated systemic insulin resistance. Locally, the accumulation of exosomes within the lesion led to a significant reduction in infarct volume and cell apoptosis, while promoting neovascularization and the recovery of motor and cognitive functions. This brain‐targeted strategy achieves a peripheral–central synergistic modulation, addressing the multi‐target requirements of diabetic stroke management. Collectively, our findings provide a novel paradigm for treating diabetic ischemic stroke and a potent strategy for the targeted delivery of growth factors to the central nervous system.

source_records.title: Engineered Brain-Targeted Exosomes Delivering FGF1 for Sustained Glycemic Regulation and Multitarget Neurovascular Protection in Diabetic Stroke.
source_records.abstract: Diabetic stroke is characterized by a hyperglycemic and pro-inflammatory microenvironment that exacerbates neurovascular dysfunction. However, the blood-brain barrier (BBB) remains a formidable obstacle, restricting the delivery of most therapeutic molecules. To address this, we developed a non-invasive treatment strategy using engineered exosomes. Specifically, we fabricated FGF1-loaded exosomes functionalized with the rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG) peptide (FGF1-RVG Exo). This platform facilitates selective, neuron-targeted delivery of FGF1 to the ischemic penumbra via RVG-mediated transcytosis. In a diabetic stroke mouse model, FGF1-RVG Exo exhibited superior pharmacological efficacy compared to free FGF1, achieving robust therapeutic outcomes with only once-weekly administration. Notably, a single dose during the acute phase elicited a sustained hypoglycemic effect lasting up to two weeks and effectively ameliorated systemic insulin resistance. Locally, the accumulation of exosomes within the lesion led to a significant reduction in infarct volume and cell apoptosis, while promoting neovascularization and the recovery of motor and cognitive functions. This brain-targeted strategy achieves a peripheral-central synergistic modulation, addressing the multi-target requirements of diabetic stroke management. Collectively, our findings provide a novel paradigm for treating diabetic ischemic stroke and a potent strategy for the targeted delivery of growth factors to the central nervous system.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Diabetic stroke is characterized by a hyperglycemic and pro-inflammatory microenvironment that exacerbates neurovascular dysfunction. The study aimed to develop a targeted therapeutic strategy to address these challenges.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized a diabetic stroke mouse model to evaluate the efficacy of an engineered exosome delivery system. The design included a comparison between the engineered exosomes and free FGF1, with the latter serving as the control.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed FGF1-loaded exosomes functionalized with the rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG) peptide to enable targeted delivery. These exosomes were administered once weekly to the mouse model, and their effects were assessed through various biological and functional endpoints.
analysis.main_results: In the diabetic stroke mouse model, FGF1-RVG Exo demonstrated superior pharmacological efficacy compared to free FGF1, achieving robust therapeutic outcomes with only once-weekly administration. A single dose during the acute phase elicited a sustained hypoglycemic effect lasting up to two weeks and effectively ameliorated systemic insulin resistance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the brain-targeted exosome strategy provides a novel approach for treating diabetic ischemic stroke by enabling targeted delivery of growth factors to the central nervous system.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer a potential new therapeutic strategy for managing diabetic stroke, which could inform future research on targeted drug delivery and glycemic regulation in neurovascular diseases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a mouse model, and the evidence is based on a single experimental setup. The findings are supported by direct observations in the model, suggesting a moderate level of confidence in their applicability to human conditions.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel treatment strategy for diabetic stroke using engineered exosomes loaded with FGF1 and functionalized with the rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG) peptide. The research aimed to address the challenges of delivering therapeutic molecules across the blood-brain barrier, which is a significant obstacle in treating neurovascular dysfunction in diabetic stroke. The methods involved creating a targeted delivery system and testing its efficacy in a diabetic stroke mouse model. The main results showed that FGF1-RVG Exo achieved superior therapeutic outcomes compared to free FGF1, with a sustained hypoglycemic effect and improved neurovascular recovery. The interpretation highlights the potential of this brain-targeted approach for treating diabetic ischemic stroke and delivering growth factors to the central nervous system. The scientific significance lies in its implications for targeted drug delivery and glycemic regulation in neurovascular diseases. However, the study is limited to a mouse model, and the evidence is based on a single experimental setup, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 糖尿病中风的特点是高血糖和促炎微环境,加剧神经血管功能障碍。该研究旨在制定有针对性的治疗策略来应对这些挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用糖尿病中风小鼠模型来评估工程外泌体递送系统的功效。该设计包括对工程外泌体和游离 FGF1 进行比较,并以后者作为对照。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员开发了负载 FGF1 的外泌体,并用 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白 (RVG) 肽进行功能化,以实现靶向递送。这些外泌体每周一次给予小鼠模型,并通过各种生物学和功能终点评估其效果。
elements_zh.main_results: 在糖尿病中风小鼠模型中,与游离 FGF1 相比,FGF1-RVG Exo 表现出更优异的药理功效,只需每周一次给药即可实现稳健的治疗效果。急性期单剂量可引起持续长达两周的持续降血糖作用,并有效改善全身胰岛素抵抗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,脑靶向外泌体策略通过将生长因子定向递送至中枢神经系统,为治疗糖尿病缺血性中风提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为治疗糖尿病中风提供了一种潜在的新治疗策略,可以为神经血管疾病的靶向药物输送和血糖调节的未来研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠模型,证据基于单一实验设置。这些发现得到了模型中直接观察的支持,表明它们对人类状况的适用性有一定的信心。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 糖尿病卒中的特点是高血糖和促炎症微环境,加剧神经血管功能障碍。然而,血脑屏障(BBB)仍然是一个巨大的障碍,限制了大多数治疗分子的输送。为了解决这个问题,我们使用工程外泌体开发了一种非侵入性 治疗 策略。具体来说,我们制造了用 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白 (RVG) 肽 (FGF1-RVG Exo) 功能化的 FGF1 负载外泌体。该平台有助于通过 RVG 介导的转胞吞作用选择性、神经元靶向地将 FGF1 递送至缺血半暗带。在糖尿病中风小鼠模型中,与游离 FGF1 相比,FGF1-RVG Exo 表现出更优异的药理功效,只需每周给药一次即可实现稳健的治疗效果。值得注意的是,急性期单剂量可引起持续长达两周的持续降血糖作用,并有效改善全身胰岛素抵抗。在局部,病灶内外泌体的积累导致梗塞体积和细胞凋亡显着减少,同时促进新血管形成以及运动和认知功能的恢复。这种针对大脑的策略实现了外周-中枢协同调节,解决了糖尿病卒中管理的多目标要求。总的来说,我们的研究结果提供了治疗糖尿病缺血性中风的新范例,以及将生长因子靶向递送至中枢神经系统的有效策略。

papers.title: AAV-DJ enables efficient, function-preserving neuronal transduction for circuit interrogation in human cortical and thalamic organoids.
papers.abstract: Neural organoids provide tractable models of human brain development, function, and disease, but adeno-associated viral vector (AAV)-based gene delivery is limited by inefficient transduction and insufficient comparative evaluation of the natural and engineered capsids. Here, we evaluated seven AAV capsids (AAV-2, -6, -9, -DJ, -2-retro, -PHP.eB, and -Cap-Mac) for transduction efficiency, cell type tropism, cytotoxicity, and functional integrity in human cortical and thalamic organoids. AAV-Cap-Mac demonstrated the highest transduction efficiency, with broad cellular tropism, but caused cytotoxicity and decreased neuronal activity. By contrast, AAV-DJ yielded efficient neuronal transduction, with preserved calcium dynamics and minimal cytotoxicity, which enabled rabies virus-based circuit tracing and all-optical physiology. Our findings reveal a capsid-dependent trade-off between transduction efficiency and functional integrity and identify AAV-DJ as an optimal serotype for robust gene delivery and physiological interrogation in organoid-based neuroscience. Combining AAV-DJ with emerging molecular and circuit-level technologies in organoids should facilitate mechanistic and translational studies of the human brain.

Here, we evaluated seven AAV capsids (AAV-2, -6, -9, -DJ, -2-retro, -PHP.eB, and -Cap-Mac) for transduction efficiency, cell type tropism, cytotoxicity, and functional integrity in human cortical and thalamic organoids. AAV-Cap-Mac demonstrated the highest transduction efficiency, with broad cellular tropism, but caused cytotoxicity and decreased neuronal activity. By contrast, AAV-DJ yielded efficient neuronal transduction, with preserved calcium dynamics and minimal cytotoxicity, which enabled rabies virus-based circuit tracing and all-optical physiology. Our findings reveal a capsid-dependent trade-off between transduction efficiency and functional integrity and identify AAV-DJ as an optimal serotype for robust gene delivery and physiological interrogation in organoid-based neuroscience. Combining AAV-DJ with emerging molecular and circuit-level technologies in organoids should facilitate mechanistic and translational studies of the human brain.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of AAV-based gene delivery in neural organoids, particularly the inefficiency of transduction and lack of comparative evaluation of capsids. The authors sought to identify an optimal AAV serotype for efficient and function-preserving neuronal transduction.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated seven AAV capsids in human cortical and thalamic organoids, focusing on transduction efficiency, cell type tropism, cytotoxicity, and functional integrity. The research was conducted using a comparative analysis of these capsids in organoid models.
analysis.methods: The authors assessed transduction efficiency, cell type tropism, cytotoxicity, and functional integrity through direct comparison of seven AAV capsids in human cortical and thalamic organoids. They measured these parameters using standardized assays and functional readouts.
analysis.main_results: AAV-Cap-Mac showed the highest transduction efficiency but caused cytotoxicity and reduced neuronal activity. In contrast, AAV-DJ achieved efficient neuronal transduction with preserved calcium dynamics and minimal cytotoxicity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight a trade-off between transduction efficiency and functional integrity among AAV capsids, with AAV-DJ emerging as the optimal serotype for robust gene delivery and physiological interrogation in organoid-based neuroscience.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that AAV-DJ can enhance the study of human brain circuits and function in organoid models, potentially advancing research into neurological diseases and therapeutic interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations in the comparative evaluation of AAV capsids and notes that the results are based on in vitro organoid models, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the efficiency and functionality of seven AAV capsids in human cortical and thalamic organoids, aiming to identify an optimal serotype for neuronal transduction. AAV-DJ demonstrated efficient neuronal transduction with preserved calcium dynamics and minimal cytotoxicity, enabling advanced circuit tracing and physiological studies. The findings reveal a trade-off between transduction efficiency and functional integrity, with AAV-DJ being highlighted as the best option for organoid-based neuroscience research. The study's results are significant for improving gene delivery methods in brain models but are limited by the use of in vitro systems. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of in vivo validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决神经类器官中基于 AAV 的基因传递的局限性,特别是转导效率低下和缺乏衣壳的比较评估。作者试图确定一种最佳的 AAV 血清型,以实现有效且保留功能的神经元转导。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了人类皮质和丘脑类器官中的 7 个 AAV 衣壳,重点关注转导效率、细胞类型趋向性、细胞毒性和功能完整性。该研究是通过对类器官模型中的这些衣壳进行比较分析来进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 作者通过直接比较人类皮质和丘脑类器官中的七个 AAV 衣壳,评估了转导效率、细胞类型趋向性、细胞毒性和功能完整性。他们使用标准化测定和功能读数来测量这些参数。
elements_zh.main_results: AAV-Cap-Mac 显示出最高的转导效率,但会引起细胞毒性并降低神经元活性。相比之下,AAV-DJ 实现了有效的神经元转导,同时保留了钙动力学和最小的细胞毒性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 AAV 衣壳转导效率和功能完整性之间的权衡,AAV-DJ 成为基于类器官的神经科学中稳健的基因传递和生理学询问的最佳血清型。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,AAV-DJ 可以加强对类器官模型中人脑回路和功能的研究,有可能推进神经系统疾病和治疗干预的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认 AAV 衣壳比较评估的局限性,并指出结果基于体外类器官模型,可能无法完全代表体内条件。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 神经类器官提供了人类大脑发育、功能和疾病的易处理模型,但基于腺相关病毒 媒介 (AAV) 的基因传递受到低效转导以及对天然和工程衣壳的比较评估不足的限制。在这里,我们评估了七种 AAV 衣壳(AAV-2、-6、-9、-DJ、-2-retro、-PHP.eB 和 -Cap-Mac)在人类皮质和丘脑类器官中的转导效率、细胞类型趋向性、细胞毒性和功能完整性。AAV-Cap-Mac 表现出最高的转导效率,具有广泛的细胞向性,但会引起细胞毒性并降低神经元活性。相比之下,AAV-DJ 产生了有效的神经元转导,并保留了钙动力学和最小的细胞毒性,从而实现了基于 狂犬病病毒 的电路追踪和全光学生理学。我们的研究结果揭示了转导效率和功能完整性之间依赖于衣壳的权衡,并将 AAV-DJ 确定为基于类器官的神经科学中稳健的基因传递和生理学询问的最佳血清型。将 AAV-DJ 与类器官中新兴的分子和电路级技术相结合,应该会促进人脑的机制和转化研究。

papers.title: Experimental Immunogenicity and Multi-Region Field Performance of a Briquette-Formulated Oral Rabies Vaccine Bait in Kazakhstan
papers.abstract: Wildlife reservoirs sustain rabies transmission despite vaccination of domestic animals, highlighting the need for oral rabies vaccination strategies adapted to contrasting ecological settings. We conducted a pilot multi-region field evaluation of a locally developed briquette-formulated oral rabies vaccine bait at purposively selected sites in four regions of Kazakhstan during 2025–2026. Overall, 9256 baits were deployed, including 4556 placed manually and 4700 distributed by aircraft. Among the manually monitored baits, apparent uptake was 57.2% (2604/4556) and ranged from 11.3% to 75.3% among region-campaign groups. Recovered baits retained their structural integrity following a controlled aerial test drop. Tetracycline fluorescence was detected in seven of ten free-ranging foxes, and six had rabies virus-neutralising antibody titres of ≥0.5 IU/mL. Following controlled oral administration of a single bait, all six initially seronegative captive red foxes and four of five captive raccoons met the predefined seroconversion criterion. These findings support the operational field feasibility of the briquette-formulated bait across contrasting selected landscapes and demonstrate oral immunogenicity under controlled conditions. The observed variation in apparent uptake indicates that bait distribution strategies should be adapted to local wildlife ecology and deployment conditions.

We conducted a pilot multi-region field evaluation of a locally developed briquette-formulated oral rabies vaccine bait at purposively selected sites in four regions of Kazakhstan during 2025–2026. Overall, 9256 baits were deployed, including 4556 placed manually and 4700 distributed by aircraft. Among the manually monitored baits, apparent uptake was 57.2% (2604/4556) and ranged from 11.3% to 75.3% among region-campaign groups. Recovered baits retained their structural integrity following a controlled aerial test drop. Tetracycline fluorescence was detected in seven of ten free-ranging foxes, and six had rabies virus-neutralising antibody titres of ≥0.5 IU/mL. Following controlled oral administration of a single bait, all six initially seronegative captive red foxes and four of five captive raccoons met the predefined seroconversion criterion. These findings support the operational field feasibility of the briquette-formulated bait across contrasting selected landscapes and demonstrate oral immunogenicity under controlled conditions. The observed variation in apparent uptake indicates that bait distribution strategies should be adapted to local wildlife ecology and deployment conditions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决野生动物 储存宿主 尽管家畜 狂犬病 传播 所面临的挑战,强调需要针对不同生态环境量身定制口服 狂犬病 疫苗接种 策略。

elements_zh.main_results: 在手动监测的诱饵中,各区域活动组的表观吸收率在 11.3% 至 75.3% 之间,十只自由放养的狐狸中有七只检测到四环素荧光,其中 6 只狐狸的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体滴度≥0.5 IU/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 诱饵吸收的变化表明分配策略必须适应当地野生动物生态和部署条件,从而证明煤饼配制的诱饵在受控环境下的操作可行性和免疫原性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为针对不同生态景观中的野生动物制定有效的口服 狂犬病 疫苗接种 策略提供了信息,支持有针对性的 监测 和干预工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果得到了现场观察和对照实验的支持,但不同地区的吸收差异可能会限制普遍性,从而导致可信度评估适中。

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管家畜有 疫苗接种,但野生动物 储存宿主 仍维持 狂犬病 传播,这突出表明需要适应对比生态环境的口服 狂犬病 疫苗接种 策略。2025 年至 2026 年期间,我们在哈萨克斯坦四个地区特意选择的地点对当地开发的煤饼配方口服 狂犬病 疫苗 诱饵进行了试点多区域现场评估。总共投放了9256个诱饵,其中人工投放4556个,飞机投放4700个。在手动监测的诱饵中,区域活动组的表观吸收率为 57.2% (2604/4556),范围为 11.3% 至 75.3%。经过受控的空中坠落测试后,回收的诱饵保持了其结构完整性。在 10 只自由放养的狐狸中,有 7 只检测到四环素荧光,其中 6 只的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体滴度≥0.5 IU/mL。在控制性口服单一诱饵后,所有六只最初血清阴性的圈养红狐和五只圈养浣熊中的四只都达到了预定的血清转化标准。这些发现支持了煤球配制的诱饵在对比选定的景观中的现场操作可行性,并证明了在受控条件下的口服免疫原性。观察到的明显吸收变化表明诱饵分配策略应适应当地野生动物生态和部署条件。

papers.title: Establishing humoral immunity to rabies in a person with multiple sclerosis through booster vaccination: A case report.
papers.abstract: It is known that certain disease-modifying therapies for multiple sclerosis impair humoral immunity; however, data on the effect of therapies on humoral immunity with human diploid cell rabies vaccine is limited. Here we present a case of a 31-year-old male with multiple sclerosis on ofatumumab who had a bat of unknown rabies status fly into his hand. Despite completing the standard rabies vaccination series per the World Health Organization recommendations, he did not establish humoral immunity until he received two additional booster vaccinations. This case highlights novel aspects of humoral immunity to rabies in a person taking ofatumumab.
papers.journal: Multiple sclerosis journal - experimental, translational and clinical

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of data on how disease-modifying therapies for multiple sclerosis affect humoral immunity to the rabies vaccine, particularly with the human diploid cell rabies vaccine.

analysis.methods: The patient completed the standard rabies vaccination series as recommended by the World Health Organization, and booster vaccinations were administered to achieve humoral immunity.
analysis.main_results: The patient did not establish humoral immunity after the standard vaccination series but achieved it following two additional booster vaccinations.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case highlights novel aspects of humoral immunity to rabies in individuals taking ofatumumab, suggesting that booster vaccinations may be necessary for adequate immune response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform future vaccination strategies for individuals with multiple sclerosis undergoing disease-modifying therapies, particularly regarding the need for booster doses to ensure immunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable, and the evidence is based on observed outcomes rather than controlled experiments.

analysis.summary_en: This case report investigates the impact of disease-modifying therapies for multiple sclerosis on humoral immunity to rabies. A 31-year-old male on ofatumumab was bitten by a bat of unknown rabies status and did not develop immunity after the standard vaccination series. He required two additional booster vaccinations to achieve humoral immunity. The case highlights the potential need for booster doses in patients on ofatumumab. The findings suggest that vaccination protocols may need to be adjusted for individuals with multiple sclerosis undergoing such therapies. However, the study is limited to a single case and lacks controlled experimental data, which reduces the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决多发性硬化症的疾病缓解疗法如何影响 狂犬病 疫苗 体液免疫的数据缺乏问题,特别是人类二倍体细胞 狂犬病 疫苗 的体液免疫。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这篇 病例报告 描述了一名 31 岁男性,患有多发性硬化症,服用奥法木单抗,他被蝙蝠咬伤,病例报告 状态未知。
elements_zh.methods: 患者完成了世界卫生组织推荐的标准狂犬病 疫苗接种系列,并给予加强剂疫苗接种以实现体液免疫。
elements_zh.main_results: 在标准 疫苗接种 系列治疗后,患者并未建立体液免疫,但在两次额外的加强剂 疫苗接种 治疗后实现了体液免疫。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例强调了服用奥法木单抗的个体对 狂犬病 体液免疫的新方面,表明加强剂 疫苗接种 可能是充分 免疫应答 所必需的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来接受疾病缓解治疗的多发性硬化症患者的 疫苗接种 策略提供信息,特别是关于需要加强剂量以确保免疫力的问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广,并且证据基于观察到的结果而不是对照实验。

papers.title: Community awareness, perception, and preventive practices towards rabies in Ethiopia: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Rabies is a major global public health problem, with case fatality rate approaching 100% once clinical symptoms appear, causing severe neurological complications and significant social and economic burdens. Ethiopia bears a high burden of rabies, with the disease remaining endemic and contributing to considerable vaccine-preventable deaths, largely due to low community awareness, inadequate preventive practices, and limited access to timely post-exposure prophylaxis. Although studies have examined community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices regarding rabies in Ethiopia; however, the reported findings vary across studies. OBJECTIVES: This review was conducted to estimate the pooled prevalence and identify associated factors of community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices related to rabies prevention in Ethiopia. DESIGN: Systematic review and meta-analysis. DATA SOURCES AND METHODS: A comprehensive and systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, ScienceDirect, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, the Cochrane Library, and the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE), together with relevant grey literature to identify studies reporting on community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices regarding rabies in Ethiopia. Data on prevalence estimates and associated determinants were extracted using Microsoft Excel and subsequently analyzed using Stata version 17.0. A random-effects model was applied to estimate the pooled prevalence, and subgroup analyses were performed to explore potential sources of heterogeneity among the included studies. Publication bias was assessed through visual inspection of funnel plots and Egger's regression test. The methodological quality of the included studies was evaluated using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal checklist. RESULTS: A total of 27 studies involving 11,964 participants were included in the final analysis. The pooled estimates of good knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good preventive practices toward rabies were 60.36%, 58.56%, and 54.62%, respectively. Individuals living in urban areas, formal education and previous exposure to rabies were positively associated with good knowledge of rabies prevention. CONCLUSIONS: Community awareness, attitudes, and preventive behaviors toward rabies in Ethiopia remain suboptimal, with disparities among rural populations and individuals with lower educational status. The findings highlight the need for focused education intervention, improved availability of vaccination and post-exposure services, and enhanced collaboration through the One Health approach. Future efforts should focus on scaling up community awareness and preventive behaviors to support rabies control. REGISTRATION: Not registered.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines rabies virus infection and rabies encephalitis in humans and animals within Ethiopia, focusing on community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices as central determinants of rabies control outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, ScienceDirect, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, the Cochrane Library, and NICE, alongside grey literature, for studies reporting community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices regarding rabies in Ethiopia. Data from 27 studies involving 11,964 participants were extracted and analyzed using Stata version 17.0 with a random-effects model to estimate pooled prevalence, subgroup analyses for heterogeneity, Egger's regression test for publication bias, and the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal checklist for methodological quality assessment.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled prevalence of good knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good preventive practices toward rabies in Ethiopia were 60.36%, 58.56%, and 54.62%, respectively, indicating suboptimal community awareness and behaviors despite the availability of preventive measures.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Reported findings on community knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices vary substantially across studies, reflecting heterogeneity in methodologies, populations, and geographic coverage, which limits comparability and generalizability of conclusions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Urban residence, formal education, and prior exposure to rabies are positively associated with good knowledge of rabies prevention, underscoring the need for targeted educational interventions, improved access to vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis, and strengthened One Health collaboration to address disparities, particularly among rural and less educated populations.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:狂犬病是全球重大公共卫生问题,一旦出现临床症状,病死率接近100%,会造成严重的神经系统并发症和巨大的社会和经济负担。埃塞俄比亚承担着 狂犬病 的沉重负担,该疾病仍然呈地方性流行,并造成大量可通过 疫苗 可预防的死亡,这主要是由于社区意识低下、预防措施不足以及及时获得 暴露后预防 的机会有限。尽管研究调查了埃塞俄比亚有关 狂犬病 的社区知识、态度和预防措施;然而,不同研究报告的结果有所不同。目的:本次审查旨在估计汇总的 患病率 并确定与埃塞俄比亚 狂犬病 预防相关的社区知识、态度和预防实践的相关因素。设计:系统回顾和荟萃分析。数据来源和方法:在 PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE、ScienceDirect、Semantic Sc​​holar、Google Scholar、Cochrane 图书馆和国家健康与护理卓越研究所 (NICE) 中进行了全面、系统的文献检索,并结合相关灰色文献来确定有关埃塞俄比亚 狂犬病 社区知识、态度和预防实践的研究报告。使用 Microsoft Excel 提取有关 患病率 估计值和相关决定因素的数据,随后使用 Stata 17.0 版进行分析。应用随机效应模型来估计汇总的 患病率,并进行亚组分析以探索纳入研究中异质性的潜在来源。通过目视检查漏斗图和艾格回归测试来评估发表偏倚。使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所 (JBI) 严格评估清单评估纳入研究的方法学质量。结果:最终分析共纳入27项研究,涉及11,964名受试者。对 狂犬病 的良好知识、良好态度和良好预防实践的汇总估计分别为 60.36%、58.56% 和 54.62%。居住在城市地区的个人、正规教育和以前接触过 狂犬病 与对 狂犬病 预防的良好了解呈正相关。结论:埃塞俄比亚社区对 狂犬病 的认识、态度和预防行为仍然不够理想,农村人口和教育程度较低的个人之间存在差异。研究结果强调需要有针对性的教育干预、提高 疫苗接种 和暴露后服务的可用性以及通过 One Health 方法加强合作。未来的努力应集中于提高社区意识和预防行为,以支持 狂犬病 控制。注册:未注册。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE、ScienceDirect、Semantic Sc​​holar、Google Scholar、Cochrane 图书馆和 NICE 以及灰色文献,以查找报告有关埃塞俄比亚 狂犬病 的社区知识、态度和预防实践的研究。使用 Stata 17.0 版提取并分析涉及 11,964 名参与者的 27 项研究的数据,其中使用随机效应模型来估计汇总 患病率、异质性亚组分析、发表偏倚的 Egger 回归测试以及用于方法学质量评估的 Joanna Briggs Institute 关键评估清单。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 埃塞俄比亚对 狂犬病 的良好知识、良好态度和良好预防实践的综合 患病率 分别为 60.36%、58.56% 和 54.62%,这表明尽管有预防措施,但社区意识和行为仍不理想。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 不同研究报告的关于社区知识、态度和预防措施的发现差异很大,反映出方法、人群和地理覆盖范围的异质性,这限制了结论的可比性和普遍性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 城市居住、正规教育和之前接触 狂犬病 与对 狂犬病 预防的良好了解呈正相关,这强调了有针对性的教育干预措施、改善获得 疫苗接种 和 暴露后预防 的机会以及加强 One Health 合作以解决差异的必要性,特别是在农村和受教育程度较低的人群中。

papers.title: Case-based learning versus Lecture for Teaching Management of Suspected Rabid Animal Exposure to Interns in an Infectious Diseases Hospital of Kolkata – A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.abstract: Introduction: Despite national programs and guidelines, medical students often fail to apply rabies management knowledge during internships, likely due to traditional teaching methods, despite the effectiveness of case-based learning. This study compared the effectiveness of case-based learning (CBL) and lectures for teaching rabies management to medical interns. Methods: A randomized educational intervention study was conducted from July to September 2024 at a tertiary care hospital in Kolkata, involving MBBS interns. Among all interns posted in a month, 64 were randomly assigned to Group A (lecture) or Group B (CBL) using block randomization. Baseline knowledge was assessed via pre-test e-questionnaire, followed by lectures or CBL, with post-test assessments immediately and one month later, and feedback collected via e-feedback form. Data were analysed using appropriate statistical software, with significance at P < 0.05, and perceptions were thematically presented. Results: Initially, each group had 32 interns, but only 27 in Group A and 28 in Group B completed both the post-tests. Both groups showed significant improvements in post-test and post 1-month scores compared to pre-test scores. Group B had significantly higher post-test total and management scores. No notable differences in satisfaction scores were found between groups. Group A desired more one-on-one interactions and clinical scenarios, while Group B enjoyed group activities. Conclusions: Students taught with CBL scored higher in post-test and management assessments, retained rabies knowledge better after a month, with similar satisfaction levels across groups. Group A wanted more one-on-one interaction and clinical case scenarios, whereas Group B valued group activities.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Medical interns often fail to apply rabies management knowledge despite national programs, likely due to reliance on traditional lecture-based teaching methods, prompting a need to evaluate alternative pedagogical approaches such as case-based learning.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A randomized controlled educational intervention study was conducted from July to September 2024 at a tertiary care hospital in Kolkata, enrolling 64 MBBS interns who were randomly assigned to either a lecture group or a case-based learning group using block randomization.
analysis.methods: Participants completed a pre-test e-questionnaire to assess baseline knowledge, followed by either lectures or case-based learning sessions, with post-test assessments conducted immediately and one month later, and feedback collected via an e-feedback form; data were analyzed using appropriate statistical software with significance set at P < 0.05.
analysis.main_results: Initially, each group had 32 interns, but only 27 in the lecture group and 28 in the case-based learning group completed both post-tests; both groups showed significant improvements in post-test and one-month scores compared to pre-test scores, and the case-based learning group had significantly higher post-test total and management scores.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that case-based learning improved immediate and retained knowledge of rabies management among interns compared to lectures, with similar satisfaction levels between groups, highlighting the pedagogical value of interactive learning methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that incorporating case-based learning into medical education could enhance the practical application of rabies management guidelines by interns, potentially improving patient care and adherence to national programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by a small sample size and attrition between pre-test and follow-up assessments, which may affect generalizability; the evidence strength is moderate due to the single-center design and lack of long-term retention data.

analysis.summary_en: This randomized controlled trial evaluated whether case-based learning (CBL) improved rabies management knowledge retention among medical interns compared to traditional lectures. Conducted from July to September 2024 in Kolkata, the study randomized 64 interns to either a lecture group or a CBL group. Both groups showed significant improvements in post-test and one-month scores relative to baseline, but the CBL group achieved significantly higher post-test total and management scores. Satisfaction levels were similar between groups, though the lecture group desired more interactive scenarios. The authors conclude that CBL enhances immediate and retained knowledge of rabies management, suggesting a role for interactive pedagogies in medical education to strengthen guideline adherence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有国家计划,医学实习生往往无法应用 狂犬病 管理知识,这可能是由于依赖传统的基于讲座的教学方法,从而促使需要评估基于案例的学习等替代教学方法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 7 月至 9 月在加尔各答的一家三级护理医院进行了一项随机对照教育干预研究,招募了 64 名 MBBS 实习生,他们使用分组随机法被随机分配到讲座组或基于案例的学习组。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了测试前电子问卷以评估基线知识,然后进行讲座或基于案例的学习课程,立即和一个月后进行测试后评估,并通过电子反馈表收集反馈;使用适当的统计软件对数据进行分析,显着性设置为P<0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 最初,每组有32名实习生,但讲座组只有27名实习生,案例学习组有28名实习生完成了两项后测;与测试前分数相比,两组的测试后分数和一个月分数都有显着提高,基于案例的学习组的测试后总分和管理分数显着更高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与讲座相比,基于案例的学习提高了实习生对 狂犬病 管理的即时和保留知识,各组之间的满意度相似,凸显了交互式学习方法的教学价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些研究结果表明,将基于案例的学习纳入医学教育可以增强实习生对 狂犬病 管理指南的实际应用,从而有可能改善患者护理和对国家计划的遵守。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小以及预测试和后续评估之间的损耗的限制,这可能会影响普遍性;由于单中心设计且缺乏长期保留数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Indirect Rabies Exposure via Oral Suction of a Cat Bite: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Introduction: Rabies is almost invariably fatal after the onset of clinical disease. Although bites and scratches are the usual routes of transmission, mucosal contact with potentially infectious saliva is also considered a severe exposure requiring post-exposure prophylaxis. Case Presentation: A 19-year-old woman presented to the emergency department after being bitten on the right hand by an unowned stray cat that could not be located for observation. During history taking, it was learned that her father had immediately performed oral suction on the bite wound as a traditional first-aid attempt. The patient was managed for a Category III exposure. Because the father's oral mucosa had directly contacted a wound potentially contaminated with cat saliva, he was also evaluated as having a secondary mucosal exposure. Rabies post-exposure prophylaxis was initiated for both individuals after infectious diseases consultation. No complications were observed during follow-up. Conclusion: This case highlights that unconventional wound interventions may create secondary rabies exposure. Emergency physicians should specifically ask about prehospital first-aid practices and should recognize mucosal contamination as a potential indication for prophylaxis when the source animal is unavailable.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 在临床发病后几乎总是致命的,尽管咬伤是 传播 的常用途径,但粘膜与传染性唾液的接触也被认为是需要 暴露后预防 的严重暴露。该 病例报告 检查非常规急救措施(例如咬伤伤口的口腔抽吸)是否会造成二次 狂犬病 暴露。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一名单例患者 病例报告 描述的一名 19 岁女性,她被流浪猫咬伤后就诊,她的父亲对伤口进行口腔吸痰,作为传统的急救措施。两人均接受 III 类 狂犬病 暴露管理并接受 暴露后预防 治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 患者的暴露被归类为 III 类,患者和她的父亲均因直接接触可能被污染的唾液而接受了二次粘膜暴露评估。狂犬病 暴露后预防是在传染病咨询后启动的。
elements_zh.main_results: 在开始 暴露后预防 后,患者或其父亲在随访期间没有观察到并发症。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此案例解释为强调非常规伤口干预措施可能会造成继发性 狂犬病 暴露,强调急诊医生需要询问院前急救实践,并认识到粘膜污染是在无法获得来源动物时进行预防的潜在指征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了将院前急救实践纳入暴露评估的重要性,并支持将粘膜污染视为 暴露后预防 管理中 暴露后预防 的有效指征。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推理;由于缺乏比较数据或更广泛的基于人群的分析,证据强度较低。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 在临床发病后几乎总是致命的,尽管咬伤是 传播 的常用途径,但粘膜与传染性唾液的接触也被认为是需要 暴露后预防 的严重暴露。该 病例报告 检查非常规急救措施(例如咬伤伤口的口腔抽吸)是否会造成二次 狂犬病 暴露。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一名单例患者 病例报告 描述的一名 19 岁女性,她被流浪猫咬伤后就诊,她的父亲对伤口进行口腔吸痰,作为传统的急救措施。两人均接受 III 类 狂犬病 暴露管理并接受 暴露后预防 治疗。
analysis_zh.methods: 患者的暴露被归类为 III 类,患者和她的父亲均因直接接触可能被污染的唾液而接受了二次粘膜暴露评估。狂犬病 暴露后预防是在传染病咨询后启动的。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在开始 暴露后预防 后,患者或其父亲在随访期间没有观察到并发症。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此案例解释为强调非常规伤口干预措施可能会造成继发性 狂犬病 暴露,强调急诊医生需要询问院前急救实践,并认识到粘膜污染是在无法获得来源动物时进行预防的潜在指征。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了将院前急救实践纳入暴露评估的重要性,并支持将粘膜污染视为 暴露后预防 管理中 暴露后预防 的有效指征。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推理;由于缺乏比较数据或更广泛的基于人群的分析,证据强度较低。

papers.title: ZOONOSE E SAÚDE ÚNICA: IMPACTOS FÍSICOS E PSICOLÓGICOS DA RAIVA EM POPULAÇÕES HUMANAS ZOONOSIS AND ONE HEALTH: PHYSICAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL IMPACTS OF RABIES ON HUMAN POPULATIONS ZOONOSIS Y UNA SALUD: IMPACTOS FÍSICOS Y PSICOLÓGICOS DE LA RABIA EN POBLACIONES HUMANAS
papers.abstract: A raiva humana é uma zoonose viral de elevada letalidade, transmitida principalmente pela saliva de animais infectados, constituindo um importante problema de saúde pública. Além dos graves danos físicos causados pelo comprometimento neurológico progressivo, a doença pode provocar impactos psicológicos e sociais significativos em indivíduos expostos, pacientes e familiares. Nesse contexto, o presente estudo teve como objetivo analisar os impactos físicos e psicológicos da raiva em populações humanas, destacando sua relevância epidemiológica e a importância da abordagem Saúde Única para sua prevenção e controle. Trata-se de uma revisão narrativa, de caráter qualitativo e descritivo, realizada a partir de buscas nas bases PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO, LILACS e Biblioteca Virtual em Saúde, além de documentos técnicos da Organização Mundial da Saúde, Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde e Ministério da Saúde. Foram incluídas publicações entre 2016 e 2026 relacionadas à epidemiologia, prevenção, impactos físicos e psicológicos da raiva e à abordagem Saúde Única. Os resultados demonstraram que a raiva permanece como uma zoonose de grande relevância, com crescente participação dos morcegos hematófagos na transmissão da doença no Brasil. Verificou-se que os impactos físicos são amplamente descritos na literatura, enquanto os efeitos psicológicos, como medo, ansiedade e sofrimento emocional, permanecem pouco investigados. Conclui-se que a abordagem da Saúde Única é fundamental para fortalecer ações integradas de vigilância, prevenção, educação em saúde e assistência às populações expostas.
authors: Elissama dos Santos da Silva Muniz
papers.journal: Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the persistent public-health burden of human rabies, a zoonotic viral disease with near-universal lethality, and asks why its physical and psychological impacts on affected individuals and communities remain insufficiently understood despite its severity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a qualitative narrative review conducted to synthesize evidence on rabies impacts, drawing on searches across PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO, LILACS, and the Virtual Health Library, alongside technical documents from WHO, PAHO, and Brazil’s Ministry of Health.
analysis.methods: Publications from 2016 to 2026 were included if they addressed rabies epidemiology, prevention, physical or psychological impacts, or One Health approaches, with no restriction on study design or geographic origin.
analysis.main_results: The review found that while physical impacts of rabies are well documented, psychological effects such as fear, anxiety, and emotional distress remain understudied, and bat-mediated transmission is increasingly implicated in Brazil.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that One Health strategies integrating surveillance, prevention, health education, and care are essential to address both the biomedical and psychosocial dimensions of rabies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for integrated surveillance and support systems that recognize the dual burden of rabies—neurological disease and psychological trauma—especially where bat reservoirs are expanding.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a narrative review without systematic methods or quantitative synthesis, the evidence strength is low, and conclusions rely on the selected literature rather than primary data.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review examines the physical and psychological impacts of human rabies within a One Health framework. It synthesizes literature from 2016–2026, highlighting that while neurological sequelae are well described, psychological effects such as fear and anxiety remain under-investigated. The authors report growing evidence of bat-mediated transmission in Brazil and conclude that integrated One Health strategies—combining surveillance, prevention, education, and care—are critical to address both biomedical and psychosocial dimensions of rabies. However, as a qualitative review without systematic methods or quantitative analysis, the evidence base is limited and the strength of conclusions is low.

papers.title: Roost switching and behavioural shifts following human disturbance of vampire bats in complex landscapes
papers.abstract: Abstract In Latin America, management of vampire bats has had inconsistent effects on the spread of lethal rabies infections from bats to humans and livestock. Positive and negative effects on rabies are hypothesised to reflect changes in bat roost fidelity and behaviour following human disturbance, but high landscape complexity has precluded monitoring bat movement in the areas where rabies transmission and bat management activity are most prevalent. We used animal-borne GPS tags to track 93 vampire bats in a rabies hotspot in the Peruvian Andes, where limited satellite visibility led to partial observation of animal locations. Immediately after capture, handling and tag application, 43% of bats, particularly males and bats with longer forearms, disappeared from the study area, suggesting a rapid roost switching response. Among the remaining 55 bats, a Bayesian state-space model revealed high individual heterogeneity on the disturbance night but on average increased flight distances. Over the remaining 8-night study period, bats gradually remained closer to the roost. These disturbance-driven shifts provide mechanisms to explain how bat disturbance can both accelerate and decelerate rabies spatial spread. More broadly, we present a modelling framework to infer key movement metrics in landscapes where GPS data limitations challenge conventional movement models.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how human disturbance of vampire bats affects rabies transmission dynamics, particularly in areas with complex landscapes where traditional monitoring methods are limited.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a rabies hotspot in the Peruvian Andes, tracking 93 vampire bats using GPS tags, with a focus on their movement patterns following disturbance events.
analysis.methods: GPS tags were used to monitor bat movement, and a Bayesian state-space model was applied to analyze the data, accounting for partial observation due to limited satellite visibility.
analysis.main_results: After capture and tag application, 43% of bats disappeared from the study area, with males and those having longer forearms more likely to leave. Among the remaining bats, movement patterns showed increased flight distances on the disturbance night, followed by a gradual return to roost proximity over the subsequent 8 nights.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that human disturbance can lead to rapid roost switching and altered movement behavior in vampire bats, which may influence rabies spatial spread dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into how bat disturbance might impact rabies transmission, informing strategies for managing rabies in wildlife populations and reducing human and livestock exposure.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on partial GPS data and a limited timeframe may affect the generalizability of findings, but the use of a Bayesian model allows for robust inference despite these constraints.

Using GPS tags, researchers tracked 93 bats in a Peruvian Andes rabies hotspot, revealing that 43% disappeared immediately after handling, with males and bats having longer forearms more likely to leave. Among the remaining bats, movement patterns showed increased flight distances on the disturbance night, followed by a gradual return to roost proximity over the subsequent 8 nights. These disturbance-driven shifts suggest mechanisms by which bat disturbance can both accelerate and decelerate rabies spatial spread. The study's findings highlight the importance of understanding bat behavior in rabies management, particularly in areas with limited satellite visibility. While the study's reliance on partial GPS data and a limited timeframe may affect generalizability, the Bayesian state-space model used provides robust inference. The results have implications for rabies surveillance and control strategies in wildlife populations.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在秘鲁安第斯山脉的 狂犬病 热点地区进行,使用 GPS 标签追踪 93 只吸血蝙蝠,重点关注它们在干扰事件后的运动模式。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how human disturbance of vampire bats affects rabies transmission dynamics, particularly in areas with complex landscapes where traditional monitoring methods are limited.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a rabies hotspot in the Peruvian Andes, tracking 93 vampire bats using GPS tags, with a focus on their movement patterns following disturbance events.
analysis_en.methods: GPS tags were used to monitor bat movement, and a Bayesian state-space model was applied to analyze the data, accounting for partial observation due to limited satellite visibility.
analysis_en.main_results: After capture and tag application, 43% of bats disappeared from the study area, with males and those having longer forearms more likely to leave. analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that human disturbance can lead to rapid roost switching and altered movement behavior in vampire bats, which may influence rabies spatial spread dynamics.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into how bat disturbance might impact rabies transmission, informing strategies for managing rabies in wildlife populations and reducing human and livestock exposure.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on partial GPS data and a limited timeframe may affect the generalizability of findings, but the use of a Bayesian model allows for robust inference despite these constraints.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract In Latin America, management of vampire bats has had inconsistent effects on the spread of lethal rabies infections from bats to humans and livestock. Positive and negative effects on rabies are hypothesised to reflect changes in bat roost fidelity and behaviour following human disturbance, but high landscape complexity has precluded monitoring bat movement in the areas where rabies transmission and bat management activity are most prevalent. We used animal-borne GPS tags to track 93 vampire bats in a rabies hotspot in the Peruvian Andes, where limited satellite visibility led to partial observation of animal locations. Immediately after capture, handling and tag application, 43% of bats, particularly males and bats with longer forearms, disappeared from the study area, suggesting a rapid roost switching response. Among the remaining 55 bats, a Bayesian state-space model revealed high individual heterogeneity on the disturbance night but on average increased flight distances. Over the remaining 8-night study period, bats gradually remained closer to the roost. These disturbance-driven shifts provide mechanisms to explain how bat disturbance can both accelerate and decelerate rabies spatial spread. More broadly, we present a modelling framework to infer key movement metrics in landscapes where GPS data limitations challenge conventional movement models.

papers.title: Exploring community awareness and perspectives on zoonotic disease in Nepal: a qualitative study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Qualitative research focused on Nepalese community perspectives on zoonotic disease is lacking. We aimed to characterise the contextual factors and mechanisms driving awareness of risk and prevention of zoonotic diseases in selected communities in Nepal. Methods We conducted 39 semi-structured individual interviews in six communities, and five focus groups with 34 participants. Ten participated in photovoice. Twenty healthcare professionals and policymakers were interviewed, 14 representing human health and six representing animal health. We analysed data thematically. Findings We generated two major themes: disease awareness, and beliefs and behaviours. Participants were aware of diseases that they had directly experienced or that they perceived might affect their family or livelihood. This was especially true of rabies. Information on disease was usually spread informally. Use of traditional medicine was widespread: some participants saw this behaviour as anachronistic, with others seeing it as pragmatic, as accessing traditional healers is often easier than visiting health posts. Consuming bushmeat was seen as something ‘others’ did, although some suggested bushmeat was medicinal and others distinguished between ‘clean’ and ‘dirty’ rodents. Hygiene practices were perceived as necessary to remove dirt but seldom linked explicitly to illness. Religious beliefs were presented as a reason for not harming rodents. Conclusion Working with communities is essential to understanding complex behaviours that might increase disease risk, especially in communities that lack resources to mitigate these threats. Specific implications for policymakers are the importance of ensuring the healthcare system is inclusive of different groups needing its services, and that differing beliefs are considered when designing services.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on understanding community awareness and perspectives on zoonotic diseases in Nepal, with a specific emphasis on rabies virus and rabies disease. The central question is to characterise the contextual factors and mechanisms driving awareness of risk and prevention of zoonotic diseases in selected communities in Nepal.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study used qualitative methods, including 39 semi-structured individual interviews in six communities and five focus groups with 34 participants. Additionally, ten participants engaged in photovoice. Data were analysed thematically.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study identified two major themes: disease awareness and beliefs and behaviours. Participants were aware of diseases they had directly experienced or perceived might affect their family or livelihood, especially rabies. Information on disease was usually spread informally, and traditional medicine was widely used due to its accessibility compared to health posts.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is heterogeneity in beliefs about traditional medicine, with some participants viewing it as anachronistic and others as pragmatic. The study also highlights a gap in understanding the link between hygiene practices and illness, as these were perceived as necessary to remove dirt but not explicitly connected to disease. Additionally, religious beliefs were presented as a reason for not harming rodents, which may influence disease prevention strategies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Policymakers should ensure the healthcare system is inclusive of different groups needing its services and consider differing beliefs when designing services. There is a need for further research into community-specific practices and beliefs that may affect disease prevention and awareness.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study explores community awareness and perspectives on zoonotic diseases, particularly rabies, in Nepal. The research aimed to characterise contextual factors and mechanisms influencing risk awareness and prevention. Data were collected through interviews and focus groups, revealing two major themes: disease awareness and beliefs and behaviours. Participants were aware of diseases they had experienced or perceived as affecting their families, with rabies being a notable example. Information was often spread informally, and traditional medicine was widely used due to its accessibility. Hygiene practices were not explicitly linked to illness, and religious beliefs influenced attitudes toward rodents. The study highlights the importance of community engagement in understanding and addressing disease risks, especially in resource-limited settings. It also underscores the need for inclusive healthcare systems and culturally sensitive service design.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是了解尼泊尔社区对人畜共患疾病的认识和看法,特别强调 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。核心问题是描述尼泊尔特定社区提高人畜共患疾病风险和预防意识的背景因素和机制。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究采用定性方法,包括对 6 个社区进行 39 次半结构化个人访谈,以及 5 个焦点小组,共有 34 名参与者。此外,还有十名参与者参与了照片语音。对数据进行了主题分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该研究确定了两个主要主题:疾病意识以及信念和行为。参与者意识到他们直接经历或认为可能影响他们的家庭或生计的疾病,尤其是 狂犬病。有关疾病的信息通常以非正式方式传播,传统医学由于与卫生站相比更容易获得而被广泛使用。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 对传统医学的看法存在差异,一些参与者认为它不合时宜,而另一些人则认为它务实。该研究还强调了对卫生习惯与疾病之间联系的理解上的差距,因为这些习惯被认为是清除污垢所必需的,但与疾病没有明确的联系。此外,宗教信仰被认为是不伤害啮齿动物的原因,这可能会影响疾病预防策略。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 政策制定者应确保医疗保健系统包容需要其服务的不同群体,并在设计服务时考虑不同的信念。需要进一步研究可能影响疾病预防和认识的社区特定实践和信仰。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 缺乏针对尼泊尔社区对人畜共患病的看法的定性研究。我们的目的是描述尼泊尔特定社区提高人畜共患疾病风险和预防意识的背景因素和机制。方法 我们在 6 个社区和 5 个焦点小组中进行了 39 次半结构化个人访谈,共有 34 名参与者。十人参加了photovoice。20 名医疗保健专业人士和政策制定者接受了采访,其中 14 名代表人类健康,6 名代表动物健康。我们对数据进行了主题分析。研究结果 我们提出了两个主要主题:疾病意识、信念和行为。参与者了解他们直接经历过的疾病或他们认为可能影响他们的家庭或生计的疾病。狂犬病 尤其如此。有关疾病的信息通常是非正式传播的。传统医学的使用很普遍:一些参与者认为这种行为不合时宜,而另一些参与者则认为这是务实的,因为接触传统治疗师通常比访问卫生站更容易。食用丛林肉被视为“其他人”所做的事情,尽管有些人认为丛林肉具有药用性,而另一些人则区分“干净”和“肮脏”的啮齿动物。人们认为卫生习惯对于清除污垢是必要的,但很少与疾病明确相关。宗教信仰被认为是不伤害啮齿动物的理由。结论 与社区合作对于了解可能增加疾病风险的复杂行为至关重要,特别是在缺乏资源来减轻这些威胁的社区。对政策制定者的具体影响是确保医疗保健系统包容需要其服务的不同群体的重要性,以及在设计服务时考虑不同的信念。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是了解尼泊尔社区对人畜共患疾病的认识和看法,特别强调 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。核心问题是描述尼泊尔特定社区提高人畜共患疾病风险和预防意识的背景因素和机制。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究采用定性方法,包括对 6 个社区进行 39 次半结构化个人访谈,以及 5 个焦点小组,共有 34 名参与者。此外,还有十名参与者参与了照片语音。对数据进行了主题分析。

news.content: The post Rabies Is 100% Fatal — and the USDA Is Airdropping the Cure appeared first on A-Z Animals . Rabies is the stuff of nightmares . Caused by the Lyssavirus, this disease is nearly impossible to cure once symptoms appear. Often, people and animals contract it after being bitten by infected creatures. Early symptoms resemble the flu, including fever, headaches, and tingling sensations. As the disease progresses, symptoms become more severe, leading to confusion, agitation, and hydrophobia. Once symptoms appear, it is already too late for treatment. Without early intervention, rabies is 100% fatal. Fortunately, vaccines administered early can stop this catastrophic disease in its tracks. Recently, the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) announced its plan to distribute an oral rabies vaccine across the country by airplane. You read that right: the government plans to distribute millions of rabies vaccines by air and road. It's an ambitious plan aimed at reducing a disease that kills countless wildlife and costs the United States hundreds of millions of dollars annually in detection, prevention, and control. Let's learn more about this oral rabies vaccine program, what it aims to do, and which parts of the country are being targeted. The government's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) plans to distribute millions of rabies vaccines in the eastern United States. On July 31st, the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) announced its annual distribution of an oral rabies vaccine. The statement from APHIS identified select areas across the eastern United States to be targeted. The goal is ambitious but simple: prevent the spread of raccoon rabies. According to the CDC, 90% of reported rabies cases originate from wildlife. As a result, many of the targeted areas are rural and have high wildlife populations. APHIS plans to distribute oral vaccines by airplane, vehicle, and bait stations. By doing this, APHIS aims to put a dent in the rabies problem and reduce the exorbitant costs associated with controlling and treating the disease. The rabies vaccine in question is called RABORAL V-RG ® . To incentivize wildlife to take it, the oral vaccine will be coated in a fishmeal attractant and packaged in two-inch plastic sachets. The announcement also made an effort to express the safety of these oral vaccines. Importantly, humans and pets cannot contract rabies from the vaccine baits. While dogs may experience upset stomachs if they eat the baits, there are no long-term health risks. However, if humans handle the baits, they should immediately wash their hands with warm water and soap. For decades, government agencies and zoonotic health organizations could only control the spread of rabies through manual efforts. However, with the advent of new vaccines like RABORAL V-RG®, rabies management has become more effective. As such, APHIS plans to expand its reach by dropping millions of vaccine packets across the eastern United States. APHIS considers the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast regions of the United States to be among the most affected areas . Across the eastern seaboard, the agency will drop several million vaccines in August. Northern New York, specifically the St. Lawrence Valley region, will receive 220,000 baits distributed by airplane, helicopter, and vehicle. Select areas of New York will also receive another type of oral rabies vaccine as part of an ongoing field assessment. APHIS plans to distribute 460,000 baits in northern Vermont, New Hampshire, and other nearby regions. Notably, northern Maine alone will receive 598,000 baits. In western Pennsylvania, APHIS will distribute more than 720,000 oral vaccine baits, while Massachusetts will receive 75,000 baits. To ensure widespread coverage, APHIS also plans to distribute more than 360,000 oral rabies vaccine baits in West Virginia and portions of eastern Pennsylvania. Many of these distribution hotspots will receive different types of vaccine baits and ongoing field assessments. In October, APHIS intends to distribute several million oral rabies vaccine baits across southern states. Over 680,000 baits will be distributed in North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and a small part of southern West Virginia. Northern Georgia and North Carolina, in particular, will receive approximately 415,000 vaccine baits. Other parts of Georgia and North Carolina, as well as Alabama and Tennessee, will receive 648,000 baits distributed by airplane and helicopter. Given its ample forests, it is perhaps not surprising that northeast and central Alabama will receive an additional 712,000 bait packets. A related program effectively eliminated the domestic dog-coyote rabies variant completely in 2008. This massive airborne distribution plan may seem excessive, but APHIS has achieved real success with its program in previous years. In fact, it has distributed more than 200 million vaccines across the country since 1995, effectively halting the spread of certain rabies variants. For example, targeted distribution in Texas reduced the outbreak zone of the gray fox rabies variant by approximately 50%. In 2008, APHIS distribution programs in Texas successfully eliminated the domestic dog-coyote rabies variant completely . This year, the focus is firmly on raccoons. APHIS hopes to stop the westward spread of the raccoon rabies variant before it reaches the central United States. If you live in one of these areas and see small packets being dropped from an airplane, you will now know what they are.
